attributes.name: highlight-toggled
attributes.description: Fill checked actions with actionBar.toggledBackground (ActionBar's highlightToggledItems), for toggle buttons such as view switchers

examples.title: Actions
examples.html: <vsc-toolbar><vsc-action icon="new-file" label="New File..."></vsc-action><vsc-action icon="new-folder" label="New Folder..."></vsc-action><vsc-action icon="refresh" label="Refresh Explorer"></vsc-action><vsc-action icon="collapse-all" label="Collapse Folders in Explorer"></vsc-action></vsc-toolbar>

examples.title: Toggle buttons
examples.html: <vsc-toolbar highlight-toggled label="View"><vsc-action icon="split-horizontal" label="Side by Side" checked></vsc-action><vsc-action icon="arrow-both" label="Swipe" checked="false"></vsc-action></vsc-toolbar>
